en: Existing update checks now include a random installation identifier for deduplicated activity and version statistics.
No additional requests, playback data collection, new settings, or permission dialogs. Automatic update checks remain enabled by default.
Updated the privacy policy and the in-app privacy summary in all 17 languages.
zh: 现有更新检查附带随机安装标识，用于去重统计活跃安装数和版本分布。
不增加请求，不采集播放数据，也不新增设置或弹窗；自动检查更新仍默认开启。
更新隐私政策，并补齐 App 内 17 种语言的隐私说明。
